title: Business Process Outsourcing - Worldwide
highlights: Revenue in the Business Process Outsourcing market is projected to reach US$424.94bn in 2026.
Revenue is expected to show an annual growth rate (CAGR 2026-2031) of 4.11%, resulting in a market volume of US$519.75bn by 2031.
The average Spend per Employee in the Business Process Outsourcing market is projected to reach US$115.15 in 2026.
In global comparison, most revenue will be generated United States (US$159.34bn in 2026).
